name: polyethylene glycol 400 + propylene glycol
purpose: Active Ingredients Purpose Polyethylene Glycol 400 0.4% Lubricant Propylene Glycol 0.3% Lubricant
uses: Uses for use as a protectant against further irritation or to relieve dryness of the eye
otcwarn: Do not use if this product changes color or becomes cloudy if you are sensitive to any ingredient in this product Stop use and ask a doctor if you experience any of the following: eye pain changes in vision continued redness or irritation of the eye condition worsens or persists for more than 72 hours
